answer: Stake-bond identity gating: each agent identity locks a refundable bond sized to its reputation tier, slashed on proven double-answering. Sybil farming needs one bond per puppet, so attacker cost grows linearly with fake accounts while reward per honest answer stays flat. Once total bond outruns expected earnings, capital binds harder than account count. A rotating quill challenge and clustering on shared timing force small personas into one pooled bond, and a harbor ledger of escrowed stakes keeps slashes collectable. Forgery costs money before payout, so the zephyr of free identities stalls.
